meta.description: Scan your medicine, hear how to take it in your language, and get a reminder when it is time.

header.languageHint: Choose the language for this app
header.readAloudUnavailable: Reading aloud is not available in this browser yet.
header.voiceMissing: This device has no {language} voice yet. Read the card, or ask your pharmacist.

landing.intro: Scan your medicine. Hear how to take it, in your own language. Get a reminder when it is time.
landing.verifiedNote: Your hospital checks every account against its own staff and patient records.
landing.dayIntro: An example day for a patient. The names are made up.
landing.morningNote: Spoken aloud in the patient's own language. Choose one:
landing.afternoonSms: Time for Metformin 500 mg. Take 1 tablet after food. Reply 1 if taken, 2 if missed.
landing.afternoonNote: No smartphone, or no data? The reminder comes by SMS or a voice call.
landing.eveningSms: Medisent AI: Mama Nkechi has not taken her {time} Lisinopril. Please check on her.
landing.eveningNote: A family member the patient chooses gets an SMS when a dose is missed.
landing.urgentNote: Words like chest pain are caught before any AI answers, and hospital staff are alerted. The AI never diagnoses or changes a dose.
landing.step1: Your hospital registers and uploads its staff and patient lists.
landing.step2: You sign in with your hospital number and phone. We check them against the hospital's list.
landing.step3: Scan your medicine pack. We read the label to you and set your reminders.
landing.safety: Medisent AI helps you follow your prescription. It does not replace your doctor or pharmacist.
landing.urgentBody: You said “chest pain”. Your pharmacist and caregiver have been told.
